propositions: The author guide currently describes a split between Acceptance Criteria (universal) and Success Criteria (containers only), but this vocabulary distinction is being collapsed across the codebase.

Documentation in writing-a-passing-plan.md, user-guide.md, and llm-framework.md must be rewritten to remove all Success Criteria vocabulary while preserving the container-specific requirement (child decomposition covering parent acceptance criteria).
The container guidance must be re-expressed as a decomposition/coverage requirement rather than becoming vacuous after Success Criteria removal.
Permanent vocabulary carve-outs in pilot/experimental and definition-of-done contexts must remain unchanged and not be modified by this rewrite.
All references to success/Success criteria must be eliminated from grep-scannable documentation and guides except for four designated carve-out locations.
